direction: The owner liked round 195 and asked to continue refining both local ship exteriors.
scope: Local Blender studies, local report and rotatable exports. Windows playable hulls are round 172.
method: Hold the previous orthographic gallery camera, scale, lighting and exposure for both models. For Glacier, project painted lip endpoints onto outboard depths measured in the plan. Compare ray hits from the painting and along the ship's side. For Delta, compare candidate footprints against the original and two sheet views. The selected roof follows the deck spine. Its sill skirt follows the receiving deck.
lighting: The selected galleries use the same 24-sample Cycles studio. Both also have a 65-degree key turn and an emitters-only control.
